translations.en: I don't know the details!
Anyway, all we need to do is head into the labyrinth.
Let's go and see!
You are now to explore the labyrinth with only vague clues to guide you.
For now, you have no choice but to search using the words Inktvis, Garnalen, Zalm,
Tong, and Schol as your guide.
Whaaat?! It's treasure hunting! Treasure hunting!
Doesn't that set your heart on fire? Where's your sense of romance?
Oh, come on! Come on, come on, come on!
Honestly! How can you call yourself an adventurer?
It's adventure! Adventure means romance, doesn't it?
And treasure hunting is the most romantic adventure of all!
Honestly! I mean, honestly, honestly!
You're no fun! But I can't go alone...
Come and talk to me if you change your mind.
Hey, hey! Listen to this!
I've heard where there's treasure. Want in?
No maps were left behind,
so rumor has it there's still plenty there.
They say there are enchanted items too,
so I bet there's some really good stuff!
And apparently, there are five different spots!
Don't you think it's worth looking?
You received an @3rElemental Wand@0r and ten bottles of @3rRestorative@0r.
I'm sorry about this...
I didn't research it thoroughly enough, and I wasted your time.
I'll be more careful next time.
But there's one thing that bothers me.
If this seal breaks, will everyone on this side
turn undead?
Suppose... just suppose, all right?
When @7rChu Lu Gah@0r made the seal, the warrior died fighting the demon god.
Then, because the demon god had attacked the warrior, the warrior turned undead.
The account mentions miasma,
so maybe even breathing in its exhalations would be enough.
If that's true, what can we do?
Isn't there some way to counter it...?
Watching @7rCyrus@0r fold his arms in thought,
you feel that he has finally begun considering
something other than escape.
Oh. Here's your reward for this time.
It might not be much, so please use these items too.
From @7rCyrus@0r, you received a reward of @3r100,000@0r and
an @3rElemental Wand@0r and ten bottles of @3rRestorative@0r.
I hope this hasn't put you off taking jobs for me.
I'll research the next one properly.
From @7rCyrus@0r, you received @3r100,000 G@0r.
Come on, hurry and get ready.
We don't have time to stand around!
Have you reconsidered?
You don't have to trust me completely.
Think of it as giving me a chance to prove myself.
Will you take this job for me?
Thank goodness. I think this will be a very difficult place to reach,
and you're the only ones I can rely on now.
Apparently, when @7rChu Lu Gah@0r created the seal,
a warrior helped him.
Of course, that warrior is dead now.
But if there was a warrior, doesn't that mean
there might be a way to fight the monster sealed away?
Of course, maybe the warrior couldn't fight it and was only there for protection.
Even so, we might learn something about defending ourselves.
To find out, I want to investigate @6rWatering Labyrinth@0r,
where the warrior's grave is supposed to be.
Even I know it's wrong
to disturb a hero's grave. But this is an emergency.
We can't afford to worry about that. I think the warrior would forgive us.
A clue to the grave was left by a thief who accompanied @7rChu Lu Gah@0r
and survived to write a journal.
Um... Oh, here it is. Listen.
My friend @7rRyud@0r was tainted by the monster's miasma.
translations.note: Ryud is a provisional historical warrior name. Source gender remains unconfirmed; the surrounding account uses neutral wording.

translations.en: Revival seemed impossible. Thus, here in @6rWatering@0r,
I will lay my friend to rest.
A broken statue on Leiden Street marks the grave.
translations.note: Leiden Street is editorial Dutch place-name orthography; the broken statue is the actual grave landmark.

translations.en: Sadly, that was the only place suitable for a burial.
I can carry back only those belongings that fit in my pockets.
Without our dependable warriors or @7rChu Lu Gah@0r,
only an ill-matched pair remains: me, a thief, and a priest.
Forgive me for bringing back so few mementos.
That's how the account ends.

context: Fiore supplies five fish-name place clues; Cyrus investigates an ancient warrior's grave using a surviving thief's account.
decisions: Control tokens remain on their source rows and in their original sequence. Genuine sentence continuations retain row boundaries; other omitted subjects are restored from scene context. Unknown historical warrior gender stays neutral. Item names follow the shared glossary; established imported prose and provenance remain intact.
